content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text resolves the Isaiah 7:14 issue by treating the sign's own silence on the mechanism as decisive rather than weighing the competing chains by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'never verse by verse' and 'stating-verse test': one reading bars using the sign's own silence on mechanism to decide the link alone; the other permits checking whether the cited verse itself states the mechanism.","why":"By resting on what the sign itself does not state, the judge applies the retired stating-verse test instead of weighing chain against chain by footing."}
